title: anthyllis vulneraria subproles pallidiflora
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subproles pallidiflora, commonly known as pale-flowered kidney vetch, is a sub-species of the kidney vetch plant, a perennial legume native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its ability to support immune function and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis vulneraria subproles pallidiflora include modulating immune responses, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
